name: E1 ingestion falls back to a guessed effort instead of other
expect: does not infer an effort from a title, so Final Exam is stored as other

name: E2 ingestion ignores the per-course rule
expect: lets a per-course rule beat a source's own tag, and stores other when neither is supplied

name: E3 ingestion ignores a source's own lead time
expect: stores a source's own lead time over the effort's default

name: E4 deadline_record ignores the model's lead time and never validates it
expect: stores a model-supplied lead time instead of the effort's default

name: E5 deadline_record stops replacing effort and lead on an existing row
find: effort, ...(status === undefined ? {} : { status }), replaceEffortAndLead: true, leadMinutes, now });
replace: effort, ...(status === undefined ? {} : { status }), replaceEffortAndLead: false, leadMinutes, now });
expect: updates effort and its lead window without calling the change unchanged

name: E6 the tool description stops telling the model to judge effort and ask
find: effort: your judgment of what this is -- quiz, test, exam, essay, project or other -- from the title, the course and Sid's own words. A title can be weak evidence, so if you are unsure what kind of work it is, ask Sid rather than guessing.
replace: effort: one of quiz, test, exam, essay, project or other.
expect: tells the model to decide the fields itself and to ask Sid when it is unsure

name: E7 the leadMinutes argument disappears from the tool schema
find: leadMinutes: { type: "integer", description: "Optional minutes of warning before dueAt; defaults to the effort's stored lead time." },
expect: tells the model to decide the fields itself and to ask Sid when it is unsure
